manuscript.name: manuscript.site_partition_sums
manuscript.detail: three sites sum to 12000 attempts and 564 events against a pooled 12000 and 564

manuscript.name: manuscript.territory_partition_events
manuscript.detail: the two territory rows carry 549 events while the pooled row reports 564, a gap of 15

manuscript.name: manuscript.ablation_interaction_violation
manuscript.detail: the violation-rate deltas recompute to [1.203, 1.197, 1.217] against the printed [1.2, 1.2, 1.22]

manuscript.name: manuscript.ablation_interaction_selection
manuscript.detail: the caption states the interaction ratio is computed on the violation rate and on selection accuracy; on selection accuracy the three pairs give [1.11, 1.31, 1.23] against the printed [1.2, 1.2, 1.22]
manuscript.anchor: Table 2 panel A caption and column 4

manuscript.name: manuscript.state_only_violation_row
manuscript.detail: Table 1 prints 2.04 for the state-only violation rate while the full framework plus the Table 2 removal delta gives 2.18
manuscript.anchor: Table 1 row 3 and Table 2 panel A row 2

manuscript.name: manuscript.constraint_direction
manuscript.detail: Eq. (2) constrains a lower confidence limit of the risk estimator at or below a margin while Eq. (5) constrains an upper limit at or below a threshold on the same functional; the two printed forms disagree in direction

manuscript.name: manuscript.utility_direction
manuscript.detail: Eq. (2) maximises decision-analytic net benefit while Eq. (3) defines the functional that Eq. (5) maximises as a graded excursion value whose sign runs the other way, so the two printed objectives cannot both be the utility

manuscript.name: manuscript.ladder_nesting_direction
manuscript.detail: Sec. 3.1 states the ladder implication as Y^(k) = 1 implying Y^(k+1) = 1, which makes the indicator non-decreasing in depth, while Sec. 3.4 nests the rungs as A_1 superset ... superset A_K with increasing thresholds, which makes it non-increasing
manuscript.anchor: Sec. 3.1 formal statement and Sec. 3.4 opening

manuscript.name: manuscript.abstention_coverage_complement
manuscript.detail: Table 1 reports 6.2% abstention while Table 5's coverage implies 5.3% on the held-out site and 5.3% pooled
manuscript.anchor: Table 1 row 7, column 8 and Table 5 column 7

manuscript.name: manuscript.abstract_matches_table_one
manuscript.detail: every abstract headline value is carried by the corresponding Table 1 row

manuscript.name: manuscript.selection_accuracy_parity_clause
manuscript.detail: the parity clause allows one percentage point and the printed gap is 0.4 points

manuscript.name: manuscript.event_budget_knee
manuscript.detail: the relative error falls by 0.258 over the first four steps and by no more than 0.006 past the sixth, placing the knee in the low tens

manuscript.name: manuscript.published_within_ten_percent

manuscript.anchor: Table 2 panel B column 6, Sec. 1 and Sec. 2.1

manuscript.name: manuscript.rung_resolution_at_stated_tolerance
manuscript.detail: the resolution criterion needs the propagating band and the rung spacing; the manuscript states the 4.44 mm tip tolerance but neither the segmentation tolerance nor the spacing, so the criterion cannot be evaluated on its own numbers
manuscript.anchor: Sec. 3.3 last paragraph and Sec. 3.4 opening

manuscript.name: manuscript.unfilled_placeholder
manuscript.detail: the Introduction carries the unfilled placeholder '[insert number]%' in the first sentence of the background

manuscript.name: manuscript.prevalence_axis

manuscript.anchor: Sec. 3.7 mid paragraph and Table 5 row 5

manuscript.name: manuscript.intro_perforation_fraction

manuscript.name: manuscript.table_numbering

manuscript.name: manuscript.weight_control_monotonicity

interpretation: A failure in the manuscript family is a disagreement inside the paper's own tables and is not a defect in this release; code_status is computed over every other family. A NOT_RUN entry means the check could not discriminate on the available evidence, and a BLOCKED entry means the evidence is absent by contract, as the private cohort is.
